about: Appearance training set (2026-10-21): generic commercial buildings labelled by Haiku from Mapillary frames with the menus in data/appearance/menus.json (main colour, accent colour, general style only). Sample 1: data/appearance/sample.json (baked commercial archetypes). Sample 2: data/appearance/sample-2.json (Assessor-coded commercial parcels). `train` = usable and confidence high/medium (Opus audits of 40 accepted rows found every doubtful accept rated low). `split` is fixed by a hash of the OSM id, about 80/20, so it is stable as data is added. Frames are in the gitignored tools/cache/appearance/.
